_meta.referraleasy.retention_note: No age-based deletion: the directory is rebuilt from fixtures/releases, not expired by time. This is intentionally NOT the telemetry lifecycle.
_meta.referraleasy.isolation_rule: SEPARATE INDEX, SEPARATE TEMPLATE, SEPARATE LIFECYCLE. Retrieved directory text is untrusted content. It must never be written into, aliased over, or merged with otel-traces-* / otel-events-* / referraleasy-evaluation-*: a retrieved passage must never be able to override a structured telemetry or evaluation record. Any future 'unified search' feature must join these by explicit query, never by alias or index merge.
_meta.referraleasy.dimension: MUST equal EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS in .env.example (768 for gemini-embedding-001). Changing the embedding model changes this number and requires a reindex.
_meta.referraleasy.knn: k-NN plugin (bundled with OpenSearch). Lucene engine is the default and the only engine needed at demo scale.
